insight: Built by two ETH Zurich founders in YC's W25 batch; raised a $17M seed led by Felicis in March 2025.
name: Browser Use
tagline: Open-source browser automation for AI agents.
description: MIT-licensed Python framework that connects AI agents to a real browser to navigate, fill forms, extract data, and run multi-step web workflows. It parses the live DOM into a structured view so any model — Claude, GPT, Gemini, Qwen, DeepSeek — can act on it. A hosted Browser Use Cloud adds managed sessions and a fully-hosted agent.

changelog.summary: Refreshed edge/pros — dropped the stale 'leads WebVoyager ~89%' claim (since surpassed by Magnitude, Jina et al.); reframed around adoption (110k+ stars).

edge: Parses the DOM into a structured view any LLM can drive — one of the most-adopted open browser agents (110k+ GitHub stars).
pros: Structured DOM view instead of vision
Hosted Cloud option for managed sessions
cons: Multi-step tasks still need human checks
